## Summary

What happened, and what did you expect instead?

## Reproduction

Provide the smallest safe reproduction, including version/commit and environment. Do not include
credentials, private endpoints, raw traces, personal data, or production secrets.

## Impact and boundaries

Which component is affected? Does this change a capability state, data lifecycle, or threat
boundary described in the repository?

## Checks already run

List relevant commands and results. A result from one environment is not a release or security
attestation.

## Security note

For potentially sensitive vulnerabilities, do not use this public template. Read `SECURITY.md`;
the repository has no published private reporting channel yet.
